purpose: The final plate under the CTA: product or book hero with clean negative space for the exact title, offer and link overlaid in post (never generated).
space_rule: Name the empty region (for example the upper third) and say it stays clean and evenly lit for overlay text.
finale_rule: Golden realism for Sketch to Life and Canvas to Life when the story earns it; lifelike 3D for Canvas to 3D; the look's own mode otherwise.
negatives: no generated text, logo or URL
no clutter in the reserved overlay space
beats_pattern: settle -> small payoff motion -> hold the final composition for the overlay
